summary: Block until one Software task reaches a terminal status.

input_schema.task_id: string | The task identifier to wait on.
input_schema.max_wait_seconds: number | optional | null | Soft deadline. When the deadline elapses before terminal, returns the most recent non-terminal row with a timed-out failure envelope.

output_schema.workspace_id: string | Workspace identifier the task was dispatched against.
output_schema.executor: string | The coding executor used for this task.
output_schema.branch: string | Branch name created for the task worktree.
output_schema.prompt_object_ref: string | optional | null | Object Store reference holding the prompt text; null when Object Store is not wired.
output_schema.status: string | Final task status (succeeded | failed | cancelled), or non-terminal status if max_wait_seconds elapsed.
output_schema.finished_at: string | optional | ISO8601 task completion timestamp; null when the wait timed out before terminal.
output_schema.commit_sha: string | optional | Commit SHA produced by the task; null when no commit was made.
output_schema.test_passed: boolean | optional | Whether the configured test_command passed; null until the test step runs.
output_schema.stdout_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for executor stdout; null until captured.
output_schema.stderr_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for executor stderr; null until captured.
output_schema.test_stdout_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for test stdout; null until captured.
output_schema.test_stderr_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for test stderr; null until captured.
output_schema.termination_reason: string | optional | Why the task terminated; null until terminal.
output_schema.failure_detail: string | optional | Human-readable failure context; null on success.

slash_command.name: code-wait
slash_command.description: block until an in-flight coding task terminates
